# ONNX Runtime Web 1.29.0

Runs the ball finder and the number reader in Safari. Copied unchanged from the npm package `onnxruntime-web@1.29.0`
(`dist/`): `ort.webgpu.min.js` and the one WebAssembly file it loads (`ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.*`), which runs
on the phone's GPU (WebGPU) when Safari offers it and on the CPU otherwise. MIT licence, (c) Microsoft Corporation:
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/blob/main/LICENSE
